title: New Car Replacement Value for Surrendered Total-Loss Vehicles, Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage
content:
**Provision.** For a total-loss vehicle surrendered to Cardinal under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage, the vehicle value is set as follows. Where the package of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy includes new car replacement, the vehicle was bought new from a dealer (its physical damage took effect without a photo inspection falling due), no more than 24 whole months have passed from the vehicle's addition to the auto policy to the loss date and the odometer at the loss is no more than 24000 miles, the vehicle value is the replacement cost new and no prior damage is deducted. Where the package includes new car replacement and the vehicle was bought new and no more than 36 whole months have passed from its addition to the loss date, but the age or the odometer limit of full replacement is exceeded, the vehicle value is the higher of the actual cash value and 75 percent of the replacement cost new, rounded to the cent. For every other vehicle the vehicle value is the actual cash value.

The age limit of 24 whole months and the odometer limit of 24000 miles are the same on every deductible option.

## Records that decide the tier

| Element | Record |
|---|---|
| New car replacement included | The package of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy |
| Bought new from a dealer | The physical damage coverage record shows no photo inspection due date |
| Vehicle's addition to the auto policy | Effective date of the vehicle's add transaction on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy |
| Odometer at the loss, replacement cost new, actual cash value | The claim's total-loss declaration |

## Tiers

| Package includes new car replacement | Bought new | Whole months from addition to loss | Odometer at loss | Vehicle value |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 24 or fewer | 24000 or fewer | Replacement cost new; no prior damage deducted |
| Yes | Yes | 24 or fewer | Over 24000 | Higher of actual cash value and 75 percent of replacement cost new |
| Yes | Yes | 25 to 36 | Any | Higher of actual cash value and 75 percent of replacement cost new |
| Yes | Yes | Over 36 | Any | Actual cash value |
| Yes | No | Any | Any | Actual cash value |
| No | Any | Any | Any | Actual cash value |

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

Replacement cost new 42000.00; 75 percent of it is 31500.00.
- 20 whole months, 18000 miles: vehicle value 42000.00, no prior damage deducted.
- 30 whole months, actual cash value 29000.00: the higher figure is 31500.00.
- 30 whole months, actual cash value 33000.00: the higher figure is 33000.00.
- 40 whole months: actual cash value.
